author: B Codex critical ownership/interface design; hand derivation only
decision: At fixed Q3/Q3, a concrete same-pool post-IOMMU physical-prefix endpoint with token buffers exactly realizes the proposed unified cell ownership and payload counts. It removes neither real permission nor original AR/R/W/B obligations. The difference is buffer/response interface integration, not an inherently extra three payload words in the ordinary control. Retain unified storage as architecture/baseline, not a unique resource mechanism.

common_contract.data: Two flows V/A, N8 aligned full Normal 64-bit words, stable immutable source snapshot, frozen original requests, no MMIO/atomics/overlap/source mutation or concurrent remap/revocation. Each independent own READ must actually succeed before its successful logical payload response.
common_contract.writes: Both destinations have usable own WRITE coverage before the associated first AW/W. For the complete simple witness, each aligned eight-word destination is in one page and uses one unchanged AW8, eight true W and one real B. Delaying A AW until its own READ succeeds avoids creating a speculative irrevocable W obligation in the denial neighbor.
common_contract.pool: Exactly P6 real payload cells; native byte-FIFO payload storage is replaced by common-pool token buffers for BOTH compared controls. No separate three-word history payload bank.
common_contract.fixed_credit: For each f, incoming-source ownership before original logical R, permission-pending optional refs, held-response pins, and DMA-copy refs count against the same Q_f=3 reservation without duplicate counting. Shared physical cells may carry both flow refs but are stored once.
common_contract.state: Each cell has data plus charged physical-source tag/attrs/snapshot epoch and mandatory/optional owner state. Per-flow ordered token queues and pending-prefix cell IDs/cursors are charged. Accepted original AR/ID/range descriptors, first miss cursor, held-R/W cell identity and source-miss state are charged. No free MSHR or pin register is assumed.
common_contract.ports: One real source-data write into the pool; R-response data lookup and W-owner data lookup plus any held-VALID staging or ports are charged alike. Token-only internal responses may reduce routing, but they change the interface; a standard RDATA endpoint must still expose correct immutable data. No area/timing estimate follows from cell count alone.
common_contract.native_error: The proper native failed-job/permission-error path is necessary in both architectures. An error-only flag or READY0 native result is not an independently successful own READ grant. This card does not claim the production error path is already implemented.

concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.location: A physical read-history endpoint accepts normal translated physical AR after actual own-READ assurance. Its shared cell allocator is also the backing storage of V/A token buffers. This replaces payload FIFO storage just as the proposed unified design does.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.issuer_ingress: On true downstream V R, allocate exactly one cell under V ingress credit, retain V delivery/copy ownership and optionally an A prefix ref. The original V upstream R carries the correct RDATA/ID/RESP/LAST and a paid cell-token identity or equivalent paired token route. Its actual original R handshake enqueues the token and advances V logical progress together, without a second payload write. Ingress-to-copy ownership is a transition, not an extra word of occupancy.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.optional_capture: Capture only contiguous prefix offsets under A fixed pending credit. At three refs or the first missed offset, stop; never hold V READY solely for unknown A. When V true W consumes its token, remove only V's ref; keep the cell if A's ref remains.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.requester_acceptance: A follows its unchanged original untranslated AR and native translation path. On successful translated physical AR, the endpoint really accepts that immutable request, saves its original ID/range and looks up the physical tag/attrs/snapshot. It does not cancel an already offered AR or advance A through a separate fake request.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.hit_response: For a hit, lock its cell before first original A RVALID. This is still charged pending/response ownership, and forbids reclaim while RVALID is held. On actual original R handshake, atomically replace that A ref by an A DMA-copy token and advance original logical progress. The payload is neither copied nor rewritten.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.miss_response: After all retained hit-prefix R have really handshaken, emit one normal downstream suffix AR, with immutable address/length/attrs within the accepted original source envelope. Convert its true R to original A ID/offset order. Only original offset7 has logical RLAST. Ingress, response and copy refs use the same A Q3 credits.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.write_response: Offer WVALID only for true head-token data under usable own WRITE permission, pin that cell/WDATA until WREADY, and drop its copy ref only on real W. Retain original WRITE/B/job obligations; no successful logical ACK at history adoption or source RLAST.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.permission_separation: Source snapshot identity is a data-sharing check, not A authority. Denied native READ produces no successful history R or target W. A successful grant to a different PA/attrs/epoch naturally misses and uses the full actual granted source read.
concrete_same_pool_post_iommu_control.firstvalid: All AR fields are fixed before their first VALID; a held R/W pins its backing cell and correct data. Optional refs not yet promised on RVALID can be discarded, but offered responses and committed copy tokens cannot be reclaimed.

exact_state_mapping.unified: V actual data cell plus normal copy token
exact_state_mapping.physical_control: one pool cell with V ingress/copy ref and the same token on real original R handshake
physically tagged prefix soft ref reserved under A pending Q3

exact_state_mapping.unified: pending-to-copy transfer on original A R handshake
exact_state_mapping.physical_control: normal hit R handshake enqueues the same cell token and replaces the pending/pinned ref
actual native own-READ assurance plus accepted physical AR/tag/epoch match

exact_state_mapping.unified: one unserved suffix after the gap
exact_state_mapping.physical_control: first-miss response cursor creates one immutable suffix AR within the accepted original AR

exact_state_mapping.unified: true W drop and original B/ACK lifetime
exact_state_mapping.physical_control: same token pin/drop and unchanged native WRITE/B completion

events: V source offsets0/1/2 occupy cells0/1/2; both V's actual copy ref and A's optional unknown-permission prefix ref are recorded, with only one data write per word.
V true W0/1/2 remove its refs. A pending refs retain cells0/1/2; cells3/4/5 remain available for V's independent Q3 incoming/copy obligations.

V receives and truly writes offsets3..7 using cells3..5 as they free. Its original logical source RLAST is offset7, its target receives all8 true W, and V original ACK waits for its real B. A has not advanced its own logical R and has no target W.

Actual own A READ succeeds and the normal physical AR8 is accepted locally. Its matching prefix3 is replayed as three real original-ID R responses, replacing pending refs with ordered A tokens on their true handshakes. Payload cells are unchanged.

A true prefix W consumes those tokens under actual own WRITE coverage. One immutable suffix AR5 starts at original offset3 after the prefix response frontier. Its five true R are normally buffered with A Q3 and only offset7 emits original RLAST.
A performs all8 true target W and receives its original real B/ACK. A suffix cells are allocated only under actual freed A credit; no original offset is repeated.
N8_Q3_late_grant_witness.cell_and_credit_ledger: After V completes: physical cells used3, A pending3, A committed0, V mandatory0; on each A hit handshake pending decreases by1 and copy ownership increases by1, so A total remains3. Real A W releases credit. Both controls peak at most6 physical cells and at most3 refs per flow. They perform13 actual source-payload pool writes, not16.
N8_Q3_late_grant_witness.upstream_AR_accounting: The local endpoint's accepted A physical AR is a real upstream request/response obligation, but it is not a third DDR data read. Downstream reads are V8 plus A suffix5. Native page-table reads and leases are common actual costs, not removed by the cache.

neighbor_grant_mismatch_or_denial.mismatch: If actual A native grant has a different physical source tag/attrs/epoch, discard only A optional refs and issue one normal full read of that actual granted source. Both architectures have physical payloadR16/dataAR2 and trueW16 in this success-miss neighbor; V data, source response and real B are unchanged.
neighbor_grant_mismatch_or_denial.denial: If A own READ is denied before any A successful RVALID/AW is published, drop its optional refs; any V refs still live remain. No successful A source payload or target W is exposed. V completes R8/W8/realB; A ends through the actual native failed-job route. Do not fabricate a successful A completion or silently cancel an accepted original request.
neighbor_grant_mismatch_or_denial.held_response: Once an authorized original RVALID or WVALID is offered, its cell is not optional, even if READY stays0. Failure/flush/revocation of such a live request requires a separate retirement protocol; the stable witness does not grant permission to revoke it.

interface_not_storage.nine_words_is_a_separate_partition_choic: A separate history3 bank plus unchanged V/A byte FIFOs3+3 uses9 payload words. It is not a lower bound for a normal physical cache given the same shared allocator/token backing store.
interface_not_storage.same_pool_copying_control: Even a same-pool normal-R copying frontend can stay within6 cells: at the real hit R handshake, release its old pending ref while assigning a new mandatory copy cell, keeping A total3. If V still shares the old cell, the shared-reference slack guarantees a free physical cell; if it does not, the old cell frees. Such a frontend pays3 extra payload writes/ports in this p3 witness, but not an unavoidable extra3 cells.
interface_not_storage.token_control: The stronger normal physical endpoint above uses the same cell identity on real R handshake and removes those3 redundant writes too. Its needed token/push interface is exactly the integration cost already charged to unified adoption.
interface_not_storage.capability_lacking_in_the_stronger_contr: None under the fixed immutable/normal/late-grant contract. The proposed separate nonclaiming prepare/adopt interface is not required for this bounded response case. A genuinely cheaper token route, error implementation or port schedule could still be a measured architectural result; there is no measured cost here.

next_precise_positive_rule.name: Reclaimable prefix borrowing with a response-commit frontier
next_precise_positive_rule.new_action_relative_to_fixed_Q: Unpublished permission-pending prefix history may borrow idle physical cells without increasing either flow's guaranteed mandatory Q3. Only actual source-ingress, offered-R pins and DMA-copy tokens are hard credits. Optional history cannot force a mandatory requester to wait.
next_precise_positive_rule.allocation: If an incoming mandatory word has own Q credit but the pool is full, select the greatest-offset evictable optional-only prefix cell, truncate the unpromised prefix at that offset and drop every later optional ref, never the cell's other mandatory refs. At least one optional-only cell exists: if all6 cells were mandatory, mandatory count would be at least6; with this arriving flow currently below3 and its peer at most3 it is at most5. Shared hard refs only strengthen that argument.
next_precise_positive_rule.response_pin: Before first RVALID, require an actual granted original AR plus one guaranteed requester hard credit and lock its exact cell. On original R handshake, transfer that hard response ref to copy ownership. Held RVALID/WVALID refs are not evictable. The allocator's own credit state, rather than combinational dependence on RREADY, qualifies this reservation.
next_precise_positive_rule.miss_commit: Do not emit the sole suffix AR before every preceding prefix R has actually handshaken. At the first missing unserved cursor, freeze MISS and emit exactly one remaining-envelope AR. Later cells cannot be counted as hit benefits inside an already committed miss. This preserves original order and firstVALID even when unpromised prefix shrinks.
next_precise_positive_rule.new_charged_state: Optional history can have up toP cell identities rather than fixedA-Q3. Charge those IDs/tags, hard/soft/held state, trim endpoint, response cursor and consume/replace ports. Soft borrowing is not six guaranteed A FIFO credits; A hard ownership stays at most3.
next_precise_positive_rule.unpressured_N8_positive: With V receiving/writing one word at a time, optional offsets0..5 temporarily occupy all6 cells. Arrival of V word6 requires a real cell, so cut optional offset5 and allocate that cell for V; permanent retained prefix is0..4 (p5). V word7 reuses the freed mandatory cell. After V finishes, actual A grant can reuse5 words, then one suffixAR3. This gives payloadR11, trueW16 and6 cells versus fixedQ history payloadR13, while V never waits for A permission.
next_precise_positive_rule.matched_control: The same-pool ordinary physical endpoint can do precisely this: store unpromised physical cache cells as soft entries, apply the same suffix trim on mandatory demand, pin only its current real original-R offer, and switch once from per-cursor local hits to one remaining miss. It needs no pre-grant adoption or extra data array. Thus p5/R11 is a positive capability over fixed quotas, not an exclusive capability over this explicit ordinary controller.
next_precise_positive_rule.pressure_neighbor: After V's N8 completion with p5, A has consumed originalR0 into one hard copy token and holds authorized R1 VALID/READY0 in a second hard cell. Optional cells2/3/4 remain. A new ordinary V three-word job uses the one free cell for its first word, then cuts optional4 and optional3 for its next two words. A's held R1 is unchanged; V now owns3 hard cells, A owns2 hard cells plus soft offset2, total6. After R1 and R2 really handshake, A's first missing cursor is3, so one suffixAR5 is committed. Original pair payloadR13, plus the pressure job'sR3, trueW19 across the three successful jobs; all original RLAST/B/ACK obligations remain real.
next_precise_positive_rule.pressure_firstvalid_counterexample: If a controller had already offered predicted suffixAR at offset5 while A R1 was held, that AR cannot be changed to offset3 after optional3/4 are reclaimed. It needs an additional hole-read/reordering contract or must pin more history. The proposed delayed-miss frontier avoids that particular recovery obligation; it does not prove that every conventional cache eagerly offers such a suffix.
next_precise_positive_rule.verdict: The elastic rule is a concrete positive design and a firstVALID-safe recovery contract to check against exact prior, but its generic soft borrowing/refcount/replacement is already ordinary. The supplied physical endpoint realizes its payload bound and recovery in the same pool. If an exact closest implementation lacks this whole response/recovery contract and a real implementation has useful total cost, the narrow contract can support an architecture contribution; counts or imagined inability of all caches do not establish firstness.

primary_scope: Root independently owns original IO-Lite TOCS2000 sections3.1/3.2/3.7 and Intel IXP2003 parent/child-reference review. Their immutable unified storage and generic reference lifetime cover the basic primitive; this seat does not claim they already implement the exact AXI prefix-cut/one-suffix recovery contract. No new prior search was done here.
next_decision: Use the concrete same-pool physical endpoint as the architecture baseline. Decide only whether the prefix-cut/firstVALID recovery contract has an exact prior and a useful implementation/resource result, or move to a new real permission/lifecycle action. Do not implement a duplicate pre-grant adoption path merely to obtain p3/p5 counts.
execution: No model, RTL/Linux changes, synthesis/build, timing matrix, repository scan or board action. Only the two specified input cards were read; Codex personally derived the ownership map and finite witnesses.
